    Help
    What each Settings section does.
    General
    Your workspace name, theme (light/dark/system), accent color, and interface language. Accent color applies across the whole app — hover states, active tabs, buttons, and focus rings. Changes save automatically and apply immediately.
    Subscription
    Your current plan, usage, and billing management. Upgrade, downgrade, or manage payment details from here.
    Notifications
    Control which events generate an alert — generation completion, publishing, billing, product updates, and Autopilot approvals. Turning a category off stops those notifications from being created, not just hidden.
    Account
    Your sign-in method and email address. Email changes require confirming the new address before they take effect.
    Security
    Change your password directly (current password required), or send yourself a password-reset link by email.
    Business
    Manage your business details, brand voice, audiences, and connected ad accounts from the Business workspace — separate from personal Settings, since it can be shared across teammates.
    Autopilot
    Automation rules that act on your campaigns without manual intervention. Recommendations that need your sign-off appear as Autopilot Approvals notifications, controlled in the Notifications tab.
    Restart Onboarding
    Replay the guided product tour from the beginning. Useful for demos or a refresher.
